bull_case: Shopify sustains high-teens/20%+ GMV and revenue growth, expands Payments and merchant services, monetizes AI/agentic commerce, and compounds owner FCF/share well above the Base path.
bear_case: Commerce growth normalizes, payment/merchant-service take economics compress, AI adds less incremental monetization than expected, and the current multiple contracts despite continued FCF growth.
thesis: Shopify is already a strong cash generator: reconstructed TTM owner FCF through Q2 2026 is about $2352M, or $1.81/share. The locked DCF produces Bear/Base/Bull values of $41.03/$124.44/$220.24 versus $128.50. Price/Base is 1.033x, so current valuation roughly requires the Base FCF/share path to be 1.03x stronger—year-10 owner FCF/share about $10.54 versus Base $10.20. This is a demanding but not Bull+ expectation; the main risk is multiple/expectation compression rather than weak current cash generation.

evidence.claim: Reconstructed TTM owner FCF through Q2 2026 is about $2352M, or $1.81/share, using OCF less PP&E capex.
evidence.source: Shopify 2025 Form 10-K, Q2 2025 Form 10-Q and Q2 2026 Form 10-Q

evidence.claim: Q2 2026 revenue grew 34% YoY and free-cash-flow margin was 18%; Q1 2026 revenue also grew 34% with a 15% FCF margin.
evidence.value: 34% Q2 growth / 18% FCF margin; 34% Q1 growth / 15% FCF margin

evidence.claim: Q2 2026 revenue was $3.583B and H1 2026 revenue was $6.753B; H1 operating cash flow was $1.139B with only $9M of PP&E purchases.
At June 30, 2026 cash plus current and long-term marketable securities were approximately $5.472B; operating lease liabilities were about $178M.

Shopify's 2024 Q2 and Q3 interim financial statements were furnished on Form 6-K and are now valid trailing-quarter equivalents because the FP pack extracts quarter/ytd financial facts from those exact documents.
evidence.source: Shopify 2024 Q2/Q3 Forms 6-K; current harness intake equivalence policy

evidence.claim: Locked Bear/Base/Bull values are $41.03/$124.44/$220.24; Base terminal value is 71.6% of operating value.
evidence.source: Deterministic harness valuation from frozen SHOP inputs

counterevidence: Q2 2026 GAAP net income benefited from equity-investment gains; owner FCF rather than EPS is the cleaner valuation anchor.
Beginning in April 2026, Canadian merchant cash advance cash flows moved from operating to investing classification, improving reported OCF/FCF comparability only after adjustment.
The frozen price still embeds durable high-teens owner-FCF/share compounding for a decade; a meaningful growth deceleration could compress value sharply.
Shopify Payments and merchant solutions expose the model to payment competition, transaction economics and consumer/merchant cyclicality.
unknowns: Normalized FCF margin after fully adjusting for the 2026 merchant-cash-advance classification change.
Incremental monetization attributable specifically to AI/agentic-commerce products.
Long-run Payments penetration and merchant-services take economics.
Five-year own-history valuation percentile under a consistent owner-FCF metric.
falsifiers: If owner FCF/share growth falls materially below the Base path for multiple quarters while GMV growth also decelerates, Base value should be cut.
If Payments/merchant-services economics compress without offsetting subscription or AI monetization, the terminal FCF path weakens.
If FCF/share compounds faster than Base with stable share count, the current expectation burden becomes easier to justify.

hard_veto_flags.veto: 현재가격이 비현실적인 Bull Case 이상을 요구
hard_veto_flags.rationale: Frozen price $128.50 is well below locked Bull value $220.24; Bull+ is not required.

key_kpis.threshold: high-teens long-run compounding with disciplined share count

key_kpis.name: GMV/revenue growth
key_kpis.threshold: durable mid/high-teens or better as scale increases

key_kpis.name: Payments penetration / merchant solutions economics
key_kpis.threshold: penetration rises without structural take-rate or loss deterioration
